suggested_fix.fix_text: The cross is between a heterozygous round plant (Rr) and a homozygous wrinkled plant (rr). The Punnett square yields 50% Rr (round) and 50% rr (wrinkled). Therefore, the offspring will produce both round and wrinkled seeds in equal proportions. The correct option is C (or the option stating 50/50 distribution).
